items.title: 68004_Howard McGhee oral history interview
items.q: He did me a lot of good as far getting my card. But I did him a lot of good by me playing at the Church.

ctx.x: Yeah, it was St. Vincent's that we put on that Eastern concert, and the joint was loaded -- I mean, it was packed. So the Reverend from St. Peter's came over and saw all those people at the church. He went immediately to the High Reverend Gensel to bring him over there, and maybe bring all these people over there to the church, because St. Peter's wasn't doing too good.
